verdict.rationale: LM Studio ships as a ready-to-run app from a dedicated download page, which also offers the headless llmster daemon. A hands-on user calls it a 'simple install' with no Python environment setup, and users note it is closed source, so prebuilt binaries are the only distribution. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-platform installers or package-manager packages, and clear evidence of Linux packaging (one older community comment complains of no proper Linux support).
